Rise of Ages es un juego de <b>estrategi: Rise of Ages is a real-time strategy game. You start with a Town Center and 5 villagers on a map you don't know: you only see what your units can see. Explore, gather resources, grow your town, advance through the ages and build an army. The team that leaves the others without any Town Center wins.
Alimento, madera, oro y piedra. Tus alde: Food, wood, gold and stone. Your villagers hunt, pick berries, fish, farm, chop and mine.
Casas, campamentos, molino, granjas, cua: Houses, camps, mill, farms, barracks, archery range, stable, towers, walls, market, temple and castle.
Aldea Primitiva, Era Tribal, Era de Pied: Primitive Village, Tribal Age, Stone Age, Metal Age and Imperial Age. Each age needs resources and buildings, and your people and buildings look better.
No sabes dónde está tu enemigo hasta que: You don't know where your enemy is until you find them. Explore the map: rivers, lakes, jungle and desert.
Hasta 8 jugadores: 1 vs 1, 2 vs 2, 4 vs: Up to 8 players: 1 vs 1, 2 vs 2, 4 vs 4, 1 vs 3… with 4 difficulty levels.

Te emparejamos con alguien de tu nivel e: We match you with someone at your level in 1 vs 1, 2 vs 2 or 4 vs 4. Winning adds points, losing takes them away, and every 100 points you level up.

Cada árbol, mina y arbusto se va acaband: Every tree, mine and bush slowly runs out while your villagers work, and you see it on the map. A felled tree leaves its stump for a few minutes. Goats can be herded so they give food without dying, or hunted. Plan ahead: what's near your Town Center won't last forever.
Arriba al centro de la pantalla siempre: At the top center of the screen you always see your current age. As you advance, your people dress better and your buildings grow bigger and sturdier. This is how the Maya evolve:
